## What does this change?

<!-- A short description of the change and why it is needed. Link the issue it fixes, e.g. "Fixes #12". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!:` / `fix!:`)
- [ ] Documentation, tests, CI or example only

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (it becomes the changelog entry).
- [ ] `dart format .`, `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass locally.
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests.
- [ ] Public API changes have dartdoc comments and, if needed, README or MIGRATION.md updates.
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or recording.
